jobs.name: Daily Research Scan
jobs.description: Full scan of all RSS feeds, arXiv, and search queries. Generates daily digest.

steps: Load feed-list.md and validate feeds
Scan all RSS feeds for new entries since last scan
Query arXiv API for recent papers in configured categories
Run configured search queries from search-queries.md
Extract findings from all sources
Evaluate and tag all findings
Check for claim conflicts and contradictions
Update source reliability scores
Update relevant dossiers
Generate daily digest
Route digest to main agent via handoff
Route urgent signals to respective agents
Log scan metadata

jobs.name: Extract Cycle — Signal Processing
jobs.description: Lightweight 6-hour scan for new signals, claim cross-referencing, and urgent routing.

steps: Check for new entries since last scan/extract
Extract key claims from new findings
Cross-reference against existing claims in vault
Flag contradictions and confirmations
Route urgent signals immediately to target agents
Queue non-urgent items for next daily scan
Update processing timestamp

jobs.name: Weekly Dossier Maintenance
jobs.description: Review and update all active dossiers. Archive stale findings.

steps: List all active dossiers
For each dossier: check for new findings since last update
Update executive summaries with new evidence
Create new dossiers if topics have 3+ unassigned findings
Archive findings older than 90 days
Retire superseded claims
Update source reliability scores
Generate maintenance report

jobs.name: Source Health Check
jobs.description: Validate all RSS feeds are responding. Mark dead feeds.

steps: Load feed-list.md
Ping each feed URL with HEAD request
Record response time and status code
Mark feeds with 5+ consecutive failures as DEAD
Log health check results
Include dead feed count in next daily digest
